tasks.title: Add one more test to Calculator test suite
tasks.description:
1. WHAT: Add one new test case to the Calculator test suite to verify that a negative result from a subtraction can be used as the first operand in a subsequent chained calculation.
2. READ FIRST: Read src/components/Calculator.test.tsx to understand the existing test structure, helpers (clickButtons, getDisplay, getButton), and the describe block layout.
3. FILES: Modify src/components/Calculator.test.tsx only — no new files needed.
4. APPROACH: Add a new it() block inside the existing 'realistic user interactions' describe block (around line 260). The test should click: ['3', '-', '8', '='] to get -5, then click ['+', '3', '='] to get -2, and assert the display shows '-2'. Use the existing clickButtons helper and getDisplay helper.
5. PATTERNS: Follow the same pattern as the 'uses result from previous calculation in new one' test — same helper usage, same assertion style.
acceptance_criteria: A new it() block is present inside the 'realistic user interactions' describe block in src/components/Calculator.test.tsx
Running `npx vitest run src/components/Calculator.test.tsx` from the project root exits with code 0 and all tests pass
